name: Salsa Sensation Latin Dance Studio
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from sabaki.dance (Latin dance aggregator) - city pages. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Name and address confirmed (Google adds unit #116). No logo image on the site (the header is text only), so logo is null. The site's schema lists a different TikTok handle (@salsasensation) than the footer link (@salsa.sensation.studio); we used the footer link. Photos are party setups from the studio rental page but show the dance floor and room clearly.
hours: Studio 5:30 PM-10 PM (class nights); phone Mon-Sat 10 AM-10 PM; closed Sun
description: A Latin dance school on Hempstead Turnpike in Levittown that teaches salsa and bachata, with month-long beginner courses (no partner needed) and occasional salsa and bachata practice socials. The studio is also rented for parties, and there is free parking behind the building.
